response.sql: SELECT original_language_id, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE replacement_cost < 20.99 GROUP BY original_language_id ORDER BY film_count DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The phrase 'using 20.99 as the replacement-cost cutoff' means films with replacement_cost strictly less than 20.99. The direction (whether qualifying films are below or above the threshold) is ambiguous and not explicitly settled by the request.

alternatives.interpretation: Qualifying films are those with replacement_cost at or below 20.99 (≤ 20.99), interpreting the cutoff as an inclusive upper limit rather than a strict boundary.
alternatives.sql: SELECT original_language_id, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE replacement_cost <= 20.99 GROUP BY original_language_id ORDER BY film_count DESC LIMIT 10

alternatives.interpretation: Qualifying films are those with replacement_cost at or above 20.99 (≥ 20.99), interpreting the cutoff as a lower threshold for selecting higher-cost films.
